record.question: Small farmers and seasonal workers typically fall under which types of poor?
record.explanation: Answer D: Churning poor. NCERT Class XI Indian Economic Development labels small farmers and seasonal workers as examples of the “churning poor,” who regularly move in and out of poverty. The answer is option 4. Reference: https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?keec1=8-10; https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/keec104.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
